databaseInUse: database is open in another process; close it to change the schema
schemaTooNew: database schema is newer than this binary
legacyNodeDatabase: database was created by the legacy Node runtime and is not supported
unknownModel: model is not in the provider catalog
modelWithoutToolCalls: model does not support tool calling
invalidEffort: effort must be one of none, low, medium, high, max, auto
conflict: config file changed since it was read
unknownAgent: agent is not in the catalog
agentNotForConversation: agent runs only as a delegated child
agentUseMismatch: agent cannot run this kind of child
runHeld: run is active in another process or engine
noFingerprint: workspace has no fingerprint (not a git repository with a commit)
taskProposalStarted: execution task proposal was already started
taskNeedsCommit: execution tasks need a git workspace with at least one commit
childLimit: subagent concurrency limit exceeded for parent session
untrustedWorkspace: mcp server is defined by the project configuration of an untrusted workspace
